{{Quote|My father used to say, May the stinging insects of a thousand worlds seek out your moist places.|Tasander Dest|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
'''Tasander Dest''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hapan]] who was raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] by his [[Tasander Dest's father|father]]. When Dest's father decided to leave, Dest chose to remain on the planet and eventually founded the [[Broken Columns Clan]], a tribe composed of men.<ref name="Backlash" />

Under Dest's leadership, the Broken Columns Clan befriended the [[Raining Leaves Clan]], a clan of traditionalist [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]]. The Broken Columns clan was the only tribe of men that did not attack the Raining Leaves Clan shortly after the [[Raining Leaves Clan massacre|massacre]] that befell their clan. The two tribes developed a custom where every year they would convene near [[Redgill Lake]] and form [[Marriage/Legends|marriages]] that lasted a year. After a few years the two clans decided to merge into one.<ref name="Backlash" />

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> during the clan's annual [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]], they suffered several attacks from the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. With the help of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], as well as other off-worlders, the two clans [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|fought off]] the Nightsisters. The two clans eventually merged into the [[Bright Sun Clan]], and was headed by the marriage of Dest to [[Kaminne Sihn]], the leader of the Raining Leaves Clan. Dest also provided the Skywalkers a deed to allow them to a new school for the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] on Dathomir.<ref name="Backlash" />
